import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 7100;
    static final int MAX_BOARD = 14;
    static final long INF = (long)1e9;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long f, c;
        Edge(int u, int v, long f, long c) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static class DinicMaxFlow {
        int s, t;
        List<Edge> e;
        List<Integer>[] g;
        int[] d;
        int[] p;

        DinicMaxFlow() {
            e = new ArrayList<>();
            g = new ArrayList[MAX_N];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            d = new int[MAX_N];
            p = new int[MAX_N];
        }

        void clear() {
            e.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
                g[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void add(int u, int v, long cap) {
            e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            g[u].add(e.size() - 2);
            g[v].add(e.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            d[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int id : g[u]) {
                    Edge ed = e.get(id);
                    if (d[ed.v] == -1 && ed.c > ed.f) {
                        d[ed.v] = d[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(ed.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long f) {
            if (u == t || f == 0) return f;
            for (int i = p[u]; i < g[u].size(); ++i) {
                p[u] = i;
                int id = g[u].get(i);
                Edge ed = e.get(id);
                if (d[ed.v] == d[u] + 1 && ed.c > ed.f) {
                    long pushed = dfs(ed.v, Math.min(f, ed.c - ed.f));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        ed.f += pushed;
                        e.get(id ^ 1).f -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxflow() {
            long res = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(p, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, INF);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    res += pushed;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static DinicMaxFlow mf = new DinicMaxFlow();
    static char[][] gridA = new char[MAX_BOARD][MAX_BOARD];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[MAX_BOARD][MAX_BOARD];
    static boolean[][] mark = new boolean[MAX_BOARD][MAX_BOARD];
    static int[][] distMap = new int[MAX_BOARD][MAX_BOARD];
    static int N, T;
    static int[] destNode = new int[103];

    static int getID(int t, int x, int y) {
        return t * N * N + (x - 1) * N + y;
    }

    static void bfsSearch(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BOARD; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_BOARD; ++j)
                distMap[i][j] = 111;

        distMap[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1}, dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            if (mark[x][y]) continue;
            mark[x][y] = true;
            distMap[x][y] = d;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 1 || nx > N || ny < 1 || ny > N || mark[nx][ny] || gridA[nx][ny] == 'Y')
                    continue;
                q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, d + 1});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            gridA[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            gridB[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        mf.clear();
        mf.s = 0;
        mf.t = MAX_N - 2;

        int startX = 0, startY = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N * N; ++i)
            destNode[i] = MAX_N - 3 - (N * N - i);

        bfsSearch(startX, startY);

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j]))
                    mf.add(mf.s, getID(0, i, j), gridA[i][j] - '0');
                if (Character.isDigit(gridB[i][j]))
                    mf.add(destNode[getID(0, i, j)], mf.t, gridB[i][j] - '0');
                mf.add(getID(0, i, j), destNode[getID(0, i, j)], INF);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1}, dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                    if (gridA[i][j] == 'Y' || gridA[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni >= 1 && ni <= N && nj >= 1 && nj <= N &&
                            gridA[ni][nj] != 'Y' && gridA[ni][nj] != 'Z' &&
                            distMap[i][j] >= t && distMap[ni][nj] >= t) {
                            mf.add(getID(t - 1, ni, nj), getID(t, i, j), INF);
                        }
                    }
                    mf.add(getID(t, i, j), destNode[getID(0, i, j)], INF);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.maxflow());
    }
}
